name: Open Path Collective
one_liner: Open Path is a nonprofit directory of therapists who see members at reduced fees ($30–$80/session) after a one-time $65 membership.
best_for: People who are uninsured or underinsured and need lower-cost therapy

short_description: Nonprofit directory of reduced-fee therapists. One-time $65 membership; sessions $30–$80, paid directly to the therapist.
long_description: Open Path Psychotherapy Collective is a nonprofit directory, not a therapy provider. Members pay a one-time $65 membership fee (refundable within 10 days) and can then book reduced-fee sessions with participating therapists in the US and Canada, online or in person. Per Open Path's FAQ, individual sessions are $40–$70, couples and family sessions $40–$80, and sessions with supervised student interns $30. You pay the therapist directly, and Open Path takes no share of session fees. Therapists do not bill insurance for Open Path sessions, though HSA/FSA funds can be used. Eligibility is aimed at people who cannot afford market rates, are uninsured or underinsured, and have household income below $100,000 (or $140,000 CAD); Open Path asks people who can use their insurance to do so.
patient_summary: You browse Open Path's directory, pay a one-time $65 membership, and contact a therapist who offers reduced-fee sessions online or in person. Sessions are typically $40–$70 (individual) or $40–$80 (couples and family), or $30 with a student intern, paid directly to the therapist. It is meant for people who are uninsured or underinsured and can't afford usual rates.

pricing.notes: Per Open Path's FAQ: individual sessions $40–$70, couples/family $40–$80, student interns $30. Sessions are paid to the therapist; Open Path takes no cut. No insurance billing; HSA/FSA can be used. Membership refundable within 10 days. Canadian prices are in CAD.

privacy.notes: Policy says it does not sell, rent or share personal information with third parties for their promotional purposes; de-identified data may be used for research. Deletion rights not confirmed. Therapy records are held by the individual therapist.

faqs.q: How much does Open Path Collective cost?
faqs.a: $65 one-time membership, then $30–$80/session. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Open Path Collective before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Open Path Collective replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Open Path Collective connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Open Path Collective?
faqs.a: Open Path Collective is available on the web.

faqs.q: What does Open Path Collective include?
faqs.a: Reduced-fee therapists; Online and in-person; Intern sessions at $30; US and Canada.
